acceptanceNote: Accepted artifacts and recorded evaluations. Publication is not independent verification of research claims.
objective:
Generate a vetting report identifying the top charity in each of the following 3 categories. Each charity MUST accept crypto/USDC donations.

CATEGORIES:
1. Natural disaster relief
2. Feeding the hungry (includes clean water access)
3. Medical research and breakthroughs

EVALUATION CRITERIA (rank by these, in order):
- Effectiveness: What percentage of each donated dollar reaches the intended beneficiary? (Use Charity Navigator, GuideStar, or equivalent ratings)
- Non-political: No partisan alignment. Must serve regardless of political affiliation of recipients.
- Transparency: Public financials, audited, accessible.
- Track record: Minimum 5 years of operation.
- Crypto acceptance: Must have a verified crypto/USDC donation channel.

DELIVERABLE:
- One charity per category (3 total)
- For each: name, website, crypto donation address/method, effectiveness score, brief 3-sentence summary of why they were selected
- Flag any red flags (governance issues, past controversies, political donations)
- Format as a clean markdown report
- This will be presented to SigmaHook governance for approval before integration
